lines.t: Let me tell you the truth from the top
From prophecy to glory
It's Gospel 101
In the beginning, the promise written in stone
Prophets proclaim the Redeemer to be known
Long awaited, some lies breaks through the night
Son of God sent to set all things right
Born of a virgin, bloodline the root
Word made flesh, wisdom taking its pursuit
No ordinary man to fullness display
Messiah walking earth in sinless parade
Healed the sick, made the dead arise
Poured living water, opened blinded eyes
Bowed in the temple, fierce with the truth
Preached love for the lowly, condemned all abuse
Tempted and tested, darkness drew near
He faced every trial, overcame every fear
Gospel 101
This is the flow
Crucified, risen, salvation bestowed
Son ascended, spirit poured from above All who call on his name, redeemed by love
One story, one king, one victory done Break chains, stand ready when he comes
They hung him high, nails in his hands Scorn and spit, world's violent demands
He bore the weight, every pain, every lie Sin upon his shoulders as he bled to die
Darkness fell, the earth shook in grief Three days later, he shattered belief
Stone rolled back, no grave could hold Risen and reigning, the story foretold
He walked with his own, showed stars in his side Promised to help her, the spirit as God
Ascended in glory, heaven received Now every heart willing, may truly believe
Gets the 101, truth made known Spirit unleashed, hearts of living stone
First and the last, alpha and N King on the clouds, about to descend
So sound the alarm, ignite and run, prepare for the day, the kingdom will come
Flames in his eyes, he returns as judge, trumpets resound, thunders emerge
Separates wheat from chaff, truth from shame, wrath for the wicked, glory for his name
Gathered his own, called to ascend, redeemed of the ages, family and friend
Kingdom established, peace on the earth, joyful creation, restored since new birth
He's coming, preparing the crowd
The king and the judge, blow trumpets loud
Lift up your soul, let faith be stirred
Wake up the nations, hold on to his word
Gospel 101
From the scroll to the beat
From prophecy fulfilled to the resurrection seat
Spirit poured out, new calling had begun
History divided, now the breakthrough's won
Gathered in glory, can God become
Alive in his kingdom, the gospel is gone
Bow down and believe, let the truth be told
No worldly power, no silver, no gold
Enough to compare or erase what's begun
This is the greatest Gospel 101
Where you gon' stand?
Gospel 101
Who's holding your hand?
Gospel 101
Freedom is found
Gospel 101
King wears the crown
